content.text:
The contact page is fixed. The long email address (`[EMAIL]`) couldn't wrap, so it spilled out of the "Other ways to reach us" card. On phones it also made the whole page wider than the screen.

I added a rule in `site/css/pages.css` that lets the contact details wrap, and the address now breaks onto a second line like the approved design. All 28 tests pass, including the contact page's desktop and phone screenshot comparisons. I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
